name: resource patch structure lab test, a patch that fails when it is applied
description: A data-only mod with one resource patch that passes prepare and fails when it is written: it removes SpawnTime from LootPickup_Gravity_Aloe and sets a field of PickupItemZone, which Aloe has not got. The whole patch is left out (SpawnTime stays) and boot.json names it once; boot-structure-test checks both.
